cases.explain: «Мудрый сын» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

cases.explain: «Здравый разум» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

cases.explain: «плохого посла» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

cases.explain: «Добрый человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
